modules.title: 改了 count，按钮文字怎么跟着变？
ref 怎样让模板文字同步变化

items.title: ref 放着当前值
items.text: ref 可以记住 count 现在是 0 还是 1。

items.title: 模板正在读取它
items.text: 按钮里的 {{ count }} 表示：这里显示 count 当前的值。

items.title: 改值后同步
items.text: 点击把 count 改掉后，Vue 找到模板里读 count 的位置，换成新的文字。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 模板会跟随响应式数据更新；普通变量变化未必触发界面更新，需先确认数据是否由 Vue 管理。

lessonPractice.title: 设置页的主题名称在输入框和预览标题中同时出现，用户输入时预览要立即变化。Vue 应该负责什么？

options.label: 让输入和预览绑定同一份响应式状态，变化时自动更新画面
options.feedback: Vue 根据状态重新显示相关组件，避免手工查找和同步多个文本节点。

options.label: 监听每次按键后直接寻找预览 DOM，并替换它的文字
options.feedback: 手工操作绕开了响应式数据来源，页面增加新预览位置后容易遗漏。

options.label: 只要使用 Vue，输入的主题名称就会自动保存到服务器
options.feedback: Vue 能更新当前界面，不会自动提供请求、数据库或长期保存。

en.title: A theme name appears in a settings input and preview heading, and the preview should change while typing. What should Vue own?

options.label: Bind input and preview to one reactive state so the view updates when it changes
options.feedback: Vue renders related components from state, avoiding manual lookup and synchronization of text nodes.

options.label: After each keypress, find the preview DOM and replace its text directly
options.feedback: Manual operations bypass the reactive source and easily miss new preview locations.

options.label: Assume using Vue automatically saves the theme name to the server
options.feedback: Vue updates the current interface; it does not automatically provide requests, databases, or persistence.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请让主题名称输入框和预览标题绑定同一份 Vue 响应式状态，输入时立即更新，不直接操作 DOM。保存按钮再调用现有接口，并测试刷新前后的未保存与已保存状态。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Bind the theme-name input and preview heading to one Vue reactive state for immediate updates without direct DOM manipulation. Let Save call the existing API, then test unsaved and saved states across refresh.

learning.assumes: You know a number on a page can change.
learning.outcome: You can see how a Vue ref and template binding keep button text in sync with a value.

modules.title: Why does the button text follow `count`?
How a ref updates template text

items.title: A ref holds the value
items.text: A ref can remember whether `count` is 0 or 1.

items.title: The template reads it
items.text: `{{ count }}` means show the current value of `count` here.

items.title: A change updates the view
items.text: When a click changes the ref, Vue updates the template locations that read it.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Templates follow reactive data. Changing an ordinary variable may not update the interface; first check whether Vue manages that data.
